fact: President Tinubu directed on 28 August 2026 a forensic audit of the Integrated Personnel and Payroll Information System, reviewing reported ghost workers and payroll fraud on the running system.
The audit directive of 28 August 2026 names GIFMIS, the Treasury Single Account and Sub-TSA as government platforms whose interfaces with IPPIS are to be examined.
The IPPIS Human Resource modules, covering payroll administration, serve over 508 federal MDAs and over 600,000 civil servants, per the Head of the Civil Service.
The IPPIS HR modules went live on 27 July 2026 on the locally developed SoftSuite platform, a migration from foreign software.
NITDA took over the Nigeria Government Enterprise Architecture infrastructure from KOICA at a handover in Abuja, reported 27 March 2026, with the NGEA described as now operational.
Federal MDAs remitted N1.96tn through IPPIS in 2024 per GovSpend data analysed by Punch; the OAGF site lists 308 MDAs fully on IPPIS.
